sloka: यद् अंतरम् सिंह शृगालयोः वनेयद् अंतरम् स्यन्दनिका समुद्रयोः ।सुर अग्र्य सौवीरकयोः यद् अंतरम्तद् अंतरम् दाशरथेः तव एव च ॥३-४७-४५॥
transliteration: yad aṁtaram siṁha śṛgālayoḥ vaneyad aṁtaram syandanikā samudrayoḥ ।sura agrya sauvīrakayoḥ yad aṁtaramtad aṁtaram dāśaratheḥ tava eva ca ॥3-47-45॥

translations.english: The difference between you and Rama is the difference between a jackal and a lion in the forest, between a ditch and the sea, and between sour gruel and the best of wines.
